page: Microsoft Azure DC48ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 48 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

For local storage requirements, the DC48ads_v6 includes 1843 GB of local SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local SSD capacity, this server type offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads. It is designed for applications requiring a mix of compute power, memory, and fast local storage, such as relational databases, medium-sized analytical workloads, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
